summary.text: Jo Ella Hoye is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 17 since January 2021 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She works as a senior analyst for the Johnson County Manager's Office and is the ranking minority member on the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Jo Ella Hoye was born in Lincoln, Nebraska, and earned a bachelor's degree from Cornell College in 2006 and a master's degree from the University of Kansas in 2009.
Her career experience includes working as a senior analyst for the Johnson County Manager's Office.
Hoye assumed office in the Kansas House on January 11, 2021, succeeding Tom Cox.

For 2025 and 2026 she is assigned to the Appropriations and House Transportation committees, and is ranking minority member on the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee and the J. Russell (Russ) Jennings Corrections and Juvenile Justice Oversight Committee.
